import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf

/-!
# Identifying kernels by sections

A monomorphism of sheaves of modules identifies its source with a kernel when
its image on every open is the kernel of the following morphism on sections.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B C : X.Modules}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Sectionwise exactness identifies a monomorphism with the categorical kernel.
The comparison is the canonical lift, so its composition with the kernel
inclusion is the given monomorphism. -/
theorem isIso_kernel_lift_of_sectionwise_exact
    (i : A ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ C) [Mono i] (h : i ≫ q = 0)
    (hexact : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(B, U)),
      q.app U r = 0 → ∃ a : Γ(A, U), i.app U a = r) :
    IsIso (kernel.lift q i h) := by
  have hinj {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) [Mono f] (U : X.Opens) :
      Function.Injective (f.app U) :=
    PresheafOfModules.injective_of_mono ((toPresheafOfModules X).map f) (op U)
  apply Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app.mpr
  intro U
  apply (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    apply hinj i U
    have heq := congrArg ((kernel.ι q).app U) hab
    simpa only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Hom.comp_app, kernel.lift_ι] using heq
  · intro r
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hexact U ((kernel.ι q).app U r) (by
      simp only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Hom.comp_app, kernel.condition,
        Hom.zero_app, AddCommGrpCat.zero_apply])
    refine ⟨a, hinj (kernel.ι q) U ?_⟩
    simpa only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Hom.comp_app, kernel.lift_ι] using ha

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
